A non-stochastic or deterministic health effect has a severity that is dependent on dose and is believed to have a threshold level for which no effect is seen . Stochastic health effects occur by chance , generally occurring without a threshold level of dose , whose probability is proportional to the dose and whose severity is independent of the dose , such as cancer and genetic effects .
